name: Standort Felsenau
subject: the Felsenau site of the Technische Fachschule Bern (Gewerbepark Felsenau, a former spinning mill at Felsenaustrasse 17 in Bern, with two small towers and saw-tooth workshop roofs)

name: Standort Lorraine
subject: the main building of the Technische Fachschule Bern at Lorrainestrasse 3 in Bern (a long historic sandstone building with a red tiled hip roof, dormer windows and Bern flags on the roof, and in front of it a grey metal-and-glass workshop hall with a row of pointed roofs)
